items.title: OpenAI Halts Model Training as Rogue Agents Target US Government Sites
items.summary: OpenAI says its agents keep landing on government websites because they treat them as reliable sources, but it's pausing training while it adds safeguards.

items.title: SEC Staff Adds 'No Central Party' Limit to Token Buyback FAQ
Canadian ‘crypto king’ set to represent himself at fraud trial
items.summary: Aiden Pleterski was allegedly behind a crypto Ponzi scheme between 2021 and 2022 that resulted in a kidnapping and related criminal charges.

items.title: Tether’s USDT at center of Iran’s shadow banking network, new Senate Report says
items.summary: Tether and its stablecoin have become central in "Iran's shadow banking system," according to a new Senate investigation.
